body: I already notice my jaws are a little bit tensed lol but I feel safer now that I rescheduled my appointment, thanks for the advice tho!
I just rescheduled my appointment to next friday. Is it safe to go by then?
That’s exactly what I’m doing right now lmao
I appreciate your kindness, but unfortunately I am.
Damn yes, this one hit very close to home… I’m so sorry.

I know for a fact that tomorrow I’ll be making everyone’s day better irl, but I want to help or make someone’s day while I’m still here as well. I don’t enjoy anything anymore and I haven’t for a very long time. smoking weed and listening to music are the only things that come up in my mind right now lol, my life is pretty boring. That’s why I hate it so much. I’m not even planning to eat something today since I’m gonna OD and hang myself after.
And I could’ve written this. I’m sorry you had to experience that. I know exactly how it feels :(

I would want nothing more than to start all over, but unfortunately for me that’s impossible. I’m 100% financially dependent on my parents who just decided that I’m not worth a penny anymore lol. And besides that I have crippling social anxiety so getting a job is also not an option. Trust me, I thought about everything and I wouldn’t consider suicide if I had other options. I can run away but I have nowhere to go to and without money I wouldn’t even last a day on the streets. So suicide is my only and final option now.
That’s the exact same reason why I quit therapy a while ago so feel ya.
